notes.title: Early Access Ver 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Ver 0.2.0

 - Add Desert region.
 - Added [Head Shot] function.
   Attacking the enemy's head can do more damage.
 - Fix explosion bug.
 - Fixed a bug where Upgrade Stone could not be purchased.

To make adding fields a little quicker, I stopped creating scenarios.
I am aware of the lack of sound effects and the problems of normal monster combat.
I will complete all field additions and reinforce the whole.

The update at the end of December is scheduled to add a fourth region and gamepad support.

I am sorry that the update is later than expected.
Thank you.

notes.title: Early Access Ver 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Ver 0.1.0

 - Activate  2 region.
 - Upgrade.
 - Ability.
 - Shop.

Currently, the Early Access version.
So the game is not finished yet.

Updates will be made every 5~14 days.
I have plans to produce all regions and stories within this year,
After that, quality improvement, additional functions and localization work will be done.

Thank you for playing this game.
